description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class `BaseDao` within the OrangeHRM project. It provides common database operation utilities such as counting records, setting sorting and pagination parameters on Doctrine QueryBuilder objects, and combining these functionalities. The class also uses traits for entity management helpers and operates with filter parameters to facilitate query customization.

classes.name: BaseDao
classes.description: An abstract Data Access Object class providing utility methods for constructing database queries with sorting and pagination, using Doctrine ORM and custom FilterParams.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the count of records from a QueryBuilder using a paginator object.

methods.name: setSortingParams
methods.description: Adds sorting to a QueryBuilder based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: setPaginationParams
methods.description: Adds pagination to a QueryBuilder based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Applies both sorting and pagination parameters to a QueryBuilder.
